sections.Profile:
The "Square Head" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in June 1963, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game with a tic-tac-toe theme. Designed by Wayne Neyens and featuring artwork by Roy Parker, it includes two flippers, five pop bumpers, four passive bumpers, two slingshots, and two gobble holes.
